Maria Chen: Quick sync — customer Evergreen asked for BYOK retention >7y and an auditable export they can retrieve within 48h. Can we commit this sprint?
Ajay Patel: Which parts are actual blockers for us? keystore handshake? search index?
Samir Rao: Tech wise: export schema for encrypted audit logs + retention labels. Also need a clear KMS escrow path.
Elaine Park: Legal flagged SOC2 needs immutable chain + proof-of-delivery. 48h is tight but possible if we pre-index metadata and have an ops fallback.
Maria Chen: Proposed MVP launch criteria: 1) signed JSONL evidence export (manifest + signature) 2) tenant-level retention labels 3) documented BYOK handshake (manual + scripted) 4) ops runbook for 48h retrieval. Agree?
Ajay Patel: Implementation risk: onboarding developer flow + vendor integrations. Rough estimate: 2 dev sprints for export pipeline, 1 sprint for keystore automation, plus docs.
Samir Rao: From SRE: to guarantee 48h we need an automated retrieval job and runbook for older cold archives. Fallback: manual export via ops if automation fails. Marking SLA as P1 for enterprise pilot.
Maria Chen: Customer is fine with a pilot that includes manual steps up-front. That gives us room to ship MVP sooner.
Elaine Park: We should also require acceptance criteria from Legal: retention policy text, rotation/escrow commitments, and approved vendor list before pilot.
ops-bot: @channel board updated: keystore-onboarding (#324) added with tags [pilot][BYOK][export]. Link: https://tools/redwood/boards/324
Ajay Patel: Action items: Ajay -> scope automated handshake + vendor shortlist; Samir -> ops runbook + retrieval SLA; Maria -> draft customer pilot comms + acceptance criteria; Elaine -> legal checklist and signoff. Due: EOD Fri.
Samir Rao: I'll book a 30m runbook review Thu 11:00.
Maria Chen: Summary: ship MVP = manual-signed export + BYOK handshake docs this sprint; automation, SOC2-searchability, and KMS escrow pipeline in following sprint(s). :thumbsup:
Elaine Park: Noted. I'll circulate legal checklist and required wording for the evidence manifest by tomorrow.
Ajay Patel: Thanks — will update ticket with estimates and blockers.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — closing thread.
